      "observations": [
        "The reviewed historical reland narrows retry from any QUIT to _isDelayedQuitSent. It cancels the idle timer at connect, ignores QUIT replies, sends terminal QUIT before returning a client to the pool, and restarts envelope setup via isRetry after delayed QUIT. The delayed flag is set only after the QUIT command is sent to avoid recursive recovery.",
        "Recipient and message counts control reuse of the connection across messages. The clarified comment states that recipient threshold does not split or prevent an attempted single message with 100 or more recipients. The old server-level sendIsActive flag is removed; free-client wakeup no longer depends on a public reuseConnection field.",
        "Fixed accepted source is later: idle expiry marks _reuseConnection false, and connect replaces the socket. Current connect also cancels a separate pending forced-close timer; _sendCommand itself no longer performs this historical retry. Existing focused delayed-QUIT evidence is reused and its earlier note that reland 3049 was not yet audited is closed for source only by this packet. No changed test, network race, RFC conformance, send result or native socket execution was validated.",
        "Full retained Bug 1965690 description/comments 0–25, edits, updates/obsolete metadata/footer and full D253921 timeline/all ten actual submitted inline bodies reread.
